title: Launchpad: get your first ten customers
dek: A free two-week program for founders who have a product and no customers yet.

sections.title: Get your first ten customers in fourteen days
sections.dek: A daily email and one short call a week. No slides, no upsell. Starts the first Monday of every month.
sections.imageAlt: Geometric plate: a carriage on a rail

items.label: Daily
items.title: One task a day
items.text: A single email each morning with one task that takes under an hour.

items.label: Weekly
items.title: A short call
items.text: Twenty minutes with a founder who has done it, to unstick the week.

items.label: Always
items.title: A private group
items.text: Forty founders at your stage, sharing what worked.

sections.heading: What past cohorts did
sections.intro: Numbers from the last four cohorts, self-reported by founders.

items.quote: I had been stuck for six months. By day nine I had four paying customers.
items.name: Amara Neal

items.quote: The daily task was small enough that I never skipped a day.
items.name: Leo Brandt

sections.heading: Save your seat for the next cohort
sections.text: Seats are free and limited to forty. Tell us where to send the first email.
sections.note: No spam. One email a day for fourteen days, then nothing unless you ask.

sections.heading: Tell us about you
sections.intro: Two minutes, and we will be in touch.
